contexts.text: Then the one never appropriates to himself the delight of the other, or destroys the freedom of the other...
Whatever they have thought and machinated against another, stands forth.
Conjugial love is such that it wants to be altogether the other's...
There is the image and likeness of the one in the mind of the other.
It is very well known... that no one ought to do to another what he does not want the other to do to him.
Conjugial love is to want to be in the life of the other as a one; but mutual love is to want better for the other than for one's self. AC 2740.
It belongs to the interior man to will good to another...

He who is such is no longer conjoined with another... In the world, words conjoin; but only when the other believes that one thinks and wills good. But in the other life all thought is open; for it is communicated by the sphere... which proceeds from the other.
He who is in anger intends evil to the other... But he who is in zeal intends good to the other...
By kisses he wants to signify that he loves the other from the heart.
When anyone wants to be conjoined with another (for the sake of self), he is in evil.
The mutual love (in the Second Heaven) is such that the one loves the other more than himself.
It is known by the delight when evil befalls another.
It is from hereditary evil to love self above another; to will evil to another if he does not honour us...
Love appropriates to another what is its own... for it presents itself in another.
For fraud involves evil against another.
Thou shalt do to the neighbour as thou wouldest the other to do to thee; consequently there shall be done to thyself what thou doest to the other. Signified.

In Heaven... the intelligence and wisdom of the one is communicated to the other... because heavenly love... wills that what is its own should be another's; and therefore in Heaven no one perceives his own good to be good in himself, unless it is also in another.
The one wants all his own to be the other's.
It is a delight to all there to communicate their delights to another.
When I wanted to transfer all my delight into another, a more interior and a fuller delight continually inflowed.
Everyone there, when he thinks of another, presents to himself his face, and some things of his life; and (then) the other becomes present...

When anyone there thinks about another from the affection of speaking with him, the other at once becomes present; and they see one another face to face. In like manner when anyone thinks about another from the affection of love; but by this affection conjunction is effected, but by the other only presence. DP 50. DP 326.
It is quite different with those who love the good in another...
Each seeks an occasion to do evil to another.
That Spirits know how to transfer their own evil into another. Explained.
